info.name: Paginated ViewSet for retrieving applications for the broker.

params.name: insured
params.description:
Filter applications by insured name.

Examples:
- `?insured=Acme Inc.` - Matches applications with 'Acme Inc.' in insured name
- `?insured=Acme Inc.,Acme Corp.` - Matches applications with 'Acme Inc.' or 'Acme Corp.' in insured name

params.name: insured_id
params.description:
Filter applications by insured (business) ID. Integer.

Example:
- `?insured_id=427` - Matches applications for insured 427

params.name: coverage_type
params.description:
Filter applications by coverage type code.

Examples:
- `?coverage_type=CYBER` - Matches applications with a CYBER coverage
- `?coverage_type=CYBER,GENERAL_LIABILITY` - Matches applications with CYBER or GENERAL_LIABILITY coverages

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter applications by status.

Examples:
- `?status=in_progress` - Matches in-progress applications
- `?status=in_progress,submitted` - Matches in-progress or submitted applications

params.name: agent
params.description:
Filter applications by assigned team member.

Examples:
- `?agent=123` - Matches applications where agent id 123 is assigned
- `?agent=123,456` - Matches applications where agent id 123 or 456 is assigned

params.name: submission_type
params.description:
Filter applications by submission type. Supports comma-separated values.

Available values:
- `NEW` - New business submissions
- `RENEWAL` - Renewal submissions
- `OTHER` - Other submission types

Examples:
- `?submission_type=NEW` - Matches new business submissions
- `?submission_type=NEW,RENEWAL` - Matches new or renewal submissions

params.name: effective_date_min
params.description:
Filter applications by minimum effective date (inclusive). Use ISO 8601 date format.

Examples:
- `?effective_date_min=2024-01-01` - Matches applications with effective date on or after January 1, 2024

params.name: effective_date_max
params.description:
Filter applications by maximum effective date (inclusive). Use ISO 8601 date format.

Examples:
- `?effective_date_max=2024-12-31` - Matches applications with effective date on or before December 31, 2024

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

items.docs:
Each row represents one Application with aggregated counts and markets
rolled up across its child CoverageApplications.

Supports Filtering By:
- insured
- insured_id
- coverage_type
- agent
- status
- submission_type
- effective_date_min
- effective_date_max

Supports Searching By:
- insured
